zh: 区域营销：跨市场传播视觉与 KV 套件系统
en: Regional Marketing: Cross-Market Visual & KV Kit System

zh: 用套件化 KV 与模块化规则，实现跨市场传播资产的快速适配与规模化生产。
en: Achieving rapid adaptation and scalable production of cross-market communication assets through modular KV kits and systematic rules.

zh: 用套件化 KV 与模块化规则，实现跨市场传播资产的快速适配与规模化生产。
en: Achieving rapid adaptation and scalable production of cross-market communication assets through modular KV kits and systematic rules.

zh: 用「分层定价包装体系（袋装/圆盒/铁盒）」的模块化设计，把同一产品按入门-主流-高端拆成清晰可扩展的包装方案，兼顾开市场、建认知与拉升品牌档次。
en: Using a modular「tiered pricing packaging system (bag/round box/tin box)」design to split the same product into entry-level, mainstream, and premium packaging solutions, balancing market entry, brand recognition, and premium positioning.

zh: 袋装系列包装
en: Bag Series Packaging

zh: 袋装产品包装设计展示。
en: Bag product packaging design showcase.

zh: 分层定价包装体系
en: Tiered Pricing Packaging System

zh: 用「分层定价包装体系（袋装/圆盒/铁盒）」的模块化设计，把同一产品按入门-主流-高端拆成清晰可扩展的包装方案，兼顾开市场、建认知与拉升品牌档次。
en: Using a modular「tiered pricing packaging system (bag/round box/tin box)」design to split the same product into entry-level, mainstream, and premium packaging solutions, balancing market entry, brand recognition, and premium positioning.

zh: 主视觉呈现
en: Key Visual System

zh: 用「主视觉 KV 系统」的模块化设计，把多产品/多活动的核心主张统一到同一动效与版式语言中，支撑官网连续叙事与高识别品牌呈现。
en: Using a modular「Key Visual System」design to unify the core propositions of multiple products/campaigns into consistent motion effects and layout language, supporting continuous website storytelling and highly recognizable brand presentation.

zh: 主视觉全屏展示
en: Key Visual Fullscreen

zh: 用「主视觉 KV 系统」的模块化设计，把多产品/多活动的核心主张统一到同一动效与版式语言中，支撑官网连续叙事与高识别品牌呈现。
en: Using a modular「Key Visual System」design to unify the core propositions of multiple products/campaigns into consistent motion effects and layout language, supporting continuous website storytelling and highly recognizable brand presentation.

zh: 烟油产品系列
en: E-Liquid Product Series

zh: 用「本地化包装系统」的模块化设计，把同一烟油产品按出口市场的语言版式、尼古丁含量标注、口味识别系统等差异，拆分为可复用、易调整的包装单元，满足多国合规要求与本地审美偏好。
en: Using a modular「localized packaging system」design to split the same e-liquid product into reusable and adjustable packaging units based on export market language formats, nicotine content labeling, and flavor identification systems, meeting multi-country compliance requirements and local aesthetic preferences.

zh: Nano 产品系列
en: Nano Product Series

zh: 用「既定模具下的工艺与配色体系」的模块化设计，在共用模具结构约束下，通过表面工艺、CMF 配色与图案印刷的组合变化，实现多产品差异化视觉表达。
en: Using a modular「craft and color system within fixed molds」design to achieve differentiated visual expression for multiple products through combinations of surface treatments, CMF color schemes, and pattern printing, within the constraints of shared mold structures.

zh: Kiyomi 产品系列
en: Kiyomi Product Series

zh: 用「工艺升级 + 3D 打样验证 + 配套包装系统」的全链路设计，将概念方案落地为量产标准，确保产品在工艺升级后仍能保持视觉一致性与品牌识别度。
en: Using a full-chain design approach of「craft upgrades + 3D proofing verification + supporting packaging systems」to transform concept designs into mass production standards, ensuring products maintain visual consistency and brand recognition after craft upgrades.

zh: Spark 产品系列
en: Spark Product Series

zh: 用「本地化合规信息 + 语言版式 + 口味识别」的模块化设计，把同一产品按不同出口市场的法规要求与消费者偏好，适配为符合当地标准的包装版本。
en: Using a modular design of「localized compliance information + language formats + flavor identification」to adapt the same product to packaging versions that meet local standards based on different export market regulations and consumer preferences.

zh: Addone 产品系列
en: Addone Product Series

zh: 用「印尼本地化合规包装 + 系列配色识别」的模块化设计，满足印尼市场的法规标注要求，同时通过统一的配色语言建立系列产品的视觉关联。
en: Using a modular design of「Indonesian localized compliance packaging + series color identification」to meet Indonesian market regulatory labeling requirements while establishing visual connections between series products through unified color language.

zh: Mingcang 产品系列
en: Mingcang Product Series

zh: 用「CMF 概念分层」的设计方法，通过材质、工艺与配色的组合变化，在统一的产品形态下实现不同价格档位与目标人群的差异化定位。
en: Using a「CMF concept layering」design method to achieve differentiated positioning for different price tiers and target audiences through combinations of materials, craftsmanship, and color schemes within a unified product form.

zh: Mist Flow 产品系列
en: Mist Flow Product Series

zh: 用「包装结构信息层级 + 关键卖点标识」的设计策略，把产品核心卖点与使用信息按视觉优先级呈现，确保货架陈列与电商详情页的高效信息传达。
en: Using a design strategy of「packaging structure information hierarchy + key selling point identification」to present product core selling points and usage information according to visual priority, ensuring efficient information communication on retail shelves and e-commerce detail pages.

zh: 徽章系列
en: Badge Series

zh: 用「统一品牌识别语言」的徽章设计体系，将核心品牌符号延伸至线下周边物料，通过徽章形式强化品牌触点与用户粘性。
en: Using a unified brand identity language in the badge design system, extending core brand symbols to offline peripheral materials, strengthening brand touchpoints and user engagement through badge forms.

zh: 展架系列
en: Display Stand Series

zh: 用「统一视觉语言 + 模块化陈列系统」的展架设计，将品牌形象延伸至零售终端，实现高效的货架表达与场景化品牌触点。
en: Using a unified visual language and modular display system in the stand design, extending brand image to retail terminals for efficient shelf expression and scenario-based brand touchpoints.

zh: 周边物品系列
en: Branded Items Series

zh: 用「品牌符号延伸」的设计思路，将视觉语言渗透至线下周边物品，通过实物触点建立多维度的品牌体验与用户认知。
en: Using a brand symbol extension design approach to permeate visual language into offline branded items, establishing multi-dimensional brand experience and user recognition through physical touchpoints.

zh: 贴纸系列
en: Sticker Series

zh: 用「低成本高频触达」的贴纸物料策略，将品牌视觉以轻量化形式植入日常场景，强化品牌曝光与用户自传播。
en: Using a low-cost high-frequency touchpoint sticker strategy to embed brand visuals in daily scenarios in a lightweight form, reinforcing brand exposure and user-driven communication.

zh: 立牌系列（不规则）
en: Irregular Stand Signs

zh: 用「异形裁切 + 品牌视觉强化」的立牌设计，以不规则轮廓突破陈列噪音，实现零售终端的视觉抢夺与品牌记忆点植入。
en: Using irregular die-cut shapes and brand visual reinforcement in stand sign design to break through display noise, achieving visual capture and brand memory implantation at retail terminals.

zh: 门帖系列
en: Door Poster Series

zh: 用「高触达场景物料」的门帖设计，在用户进店前建立第一视觉印象，以低成本实现高频次的品牌曝光与入店引导。
en: Using high-touchpoint scenario door poster design to establish first visual impressions before customers enter, achieving high-frequency brand exposure and store entry guidance at low cost.

zh: 立牌系列（规则）
en: Regular Stand Signs

zh: 用「标准化版式 + 系列视觉语言」的立牌设计，在统一的尺寸规格下实现系列产品的整体陈列与品牌一致性表达。
en: Using standardized layout and series visual language in stand sign design to achieve cohesive product display and consistent brand expression within unified size specifications.

zh: 并以「跨市场快速适配」支持高频投放与渠道协同。
en: Supporting high-frequency deployment and channel collaboration through 「cross-market rapid adaptation」.

zh: 用「KV 套件系统」固定版式规则与信息层级，拆分可变字段与素材模块，并以「跨市场快速适配」支持高频投放与渠道协同。
en: Using 「KV Kit System」 to establish layout rules and information hierarchy, separating variable fields and asset modules, supporting high-frequency deployment and channel collaboration through 「cross-market rapid adaptation」.
